question: Using citizens_bank_financials.csv, identify quarter-end dates (REPDTE) where ROE is above 15. Then, using citizens_bank_full_financials.csv matched on REPDTE, compute the average of its LIAB values for those dates, and subtract the average of EQ for those dates from citizens_bank_financials.csv. Round to 2 decimals.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
f=pd.read_csv(D+'/citizens_bank_financials.csv');g=pd.read_csv(D+'/citizens_bank_full_financials.csv')
d=f[f.ROE>15].REPDTE
print(round(g[g.REPDTE.isin(d)].LIAB.mean()-f[f.REPDTE.isin(d)].EQ.mean(),2))
